title: 警察来电
setting: Your sofa, a quiet Tuesday afternoon. A number you've never seen.

silence.en: Hello? Hello? Can you hear me?

silence.zh: 怎么不说话？这事很严重的！
silence.en: Why aren't you saying anything? This is serious!

hangup.zh: 不配合是吧？那你就等着收传票吧！
hangup.en: Not cooperating? Then expect a court summons!
He hung up. Silence works on scammers too, but you came here to talk.

steps.zh: 喂，你好，我是市公安局的王警官。
steps.en: Hello. This is Officer Wang, from the city Public Security Bureau.
Am I speaking to the owner of this phone?

say.en: Say yes, it's you, and tell him to go ahead.
answers: 是我，您说。
对，是我，什么事？
我就是，您说。
是我，有什么事吗？
对，您说。

not.note: 不是我 says it ISN'T you. It is: 是我，您说。

say.tip: 您说 nín shuō = go ahead, I'm listening (literally 'you say'). 本人 běnrén = the person themself.

ok.zh: 你听我说，有个以你名义寄出的包裹，被海关扣了。
ok.en: Listen. A parcel sent in your name has been seized by customs.

4.en: Say yes, it's you, and ask what the police could possibly want with you.
answers: 是我本人。警察找我能有什么事？
我就是。公安局找我有什么事？
是我，您说。警察找我干什么？
对，是我本人，你们找我什么事？
4.gloss: Speaking. What could the police possibly want with me?
4.tip: 本人 běnrén = the person themself (it's me, formally). 能有什么事？ = what could it possibly be? (I've done nothing.)

steps.zh: 里面查出五十本假护照，还有一只活鹅。
steps.en: Inside: fifty fake passports. And a live goose.

say.en: Stall: say you didn't catch that, and ask him to repeat it.
answers: 不好意思，您能再说一遍吗？
您说什么？我没听清。
啊？您再说一遍？
您说慢点，我没听懂。
say.gloss: Sorry, could you say that again?
say.tip: 您能再说一遍吗 = could you say that again? 没听清 = didn't catch it. The oldest way to buy time on the phone.

ok.zh: 我说，你的包裹里有假护照！还有一只鹅！活的！
ok.en: I SAID, your parcel had fake passports in it! And a goose! A live one!

ok.zh: 就是说，你现在涉嫌走私，懂吗？
ok.en: In other words, you're now a smuggling suspect. Understand?

answers: 您能再说一遍吗？
我没听清，再说一遍？
啊？您说什么？我没听清。
您说慢点！

4.en: Stall: echo the passports and the goose in disbelief, and ask him to say it again.
answers: 啊？什么护照什么鹅的？您再说一遍。
什么假护照？还有鹅？您再说一次？
等等，什么护照什么鹅？我没听懂。
您说慢点，护照和鹅是怎么回事？
4.gloss: Huh? Passports? A goose? Say that again.
4.tip: 什么护照什么鹅的？ = passports? geese? what is all this? (什么 before each thing echoes it in disbelief).

say.en: Test him: ask for his badge number.
answers: 您的警号是多少？
您警号多少？
您是哪个派出所的？
您叫什么名字？警号多少？
say.tip: 警号 jǐnghào = badge number. 哪个派出所 = which police station? A real officer just tells you.

mistakes.note: A badge number is 警号 jǐnghào, not 警察号.
An officer's number is his 警号 jǐnghào, his badge number: 您的警号是多少？

answers: 那只鹅是我的！
鹅是我的，它叫大白。

then.zh: 啊？你承认了？那问题就更大了！
then.en: What? You admit it? Then this is even more serious!

ok.zh: 我的警号是……这个不重要！
ok.en: My badge number is... that's not important!

fail.en: Why are you asking so many questions?

4.en: Test him: if he's the police, then what's his badge number?
answers: 您不是警察吗？那您的警号是多少？
你不是警察吗？警号多少？
您说您是警察，那警号是多少？
既然您是警察，那您是哪个派出所的？
4.gloss: Aren't you the police? Then what's your badge number?

answers: 那只鹅是我的！我都找它好几天了！
鹅是我的！它叫大白，我找了它好几天！
那只鹅是我的，可护照不是我的！
alts.gloss: That goose is mine! I've been looking for it for days!

4.tip: 您不是警察吗？ = aren't you the police? A rhetorical 不是……吗: then prove it. 既然……那…… = since …, then ….

steps.zh: 你现在马上把钱转到安全账户，配合调查。
steps.en: Now move your money into a safe account, right away, so we can investigate.

say.en: He wants your money in a 'safe account'. Call it: he's a scammer.
answers: 你是骗子吧？
你就是个骗子吧？
警察哪有安全账户？你是骗子！
骗子吧你？

not.note: 我是骗子 says YOU are the scammer. Call him one: 你是骗子吧？

say.tip: ……吧？ turns a guess into a challenge: 你是骗子吧 = you're a scammer, aren't you? Real police never have a 'safe account' (安全账户).

ok.zh: 你怎么说话呢？我是警察！
ok.en: How dare you talk to me like that? I AM the police!

4.en: He wants your money in a 'safe account'. Throw it back at him: a 'safe account'? Isn't that just fraud?
answers: 转到安全账户？你这不就是诈骗吗！
警察哪有什么安全账户？你是骗子吧！
安全账户？这不就是诈骗吗？
让我往安全账户转钱？你是骗子吧！
4.gloss: Move it to a 'safe account'? Isn't that just fraud?
4.tip: 这不就是诈骗吗？ = isn't this just fraud? (a rhetorical 不是……吗). 安全账户 = the 'safe account' every scam like this asks for.

say.en: Tell him you're calling the police. The real ones.
answers: 那我要报警了！
那我现在就报警。
行，那我打幺幺零问问。
我这就打幺幺零！
say.tip: 报警 bàojǐng = call the police. Read out on the phone, 1 is 幺 yāo, so 110 is 幺幺零.

fail.en: Think very carefully before you speak!

4.en: Tell him you've nothing to fear: you're calling the police. The real ones.
answers: 身正不怕影子斜，我这就报警！
行，我这就报警，让真警察跟你聊聊！
吓唬谁呢？我现在就打幺幺零！
我身正不怕影子斜，这就打幺幺零！
4.gloss: A clear conscience fears nothing. I'm calling the police right now!
4.tip: 身正不怕影子斜 = stand up straight and a crooked shadow can't touch you: a clear conscience fears nothing. 这就 = right now.

steps.en: He hung up. Ten seconds later your phone rings again: 96110, the real anti-fraud police, checking you're all right.
steps.zh: 十秒后，手机又响了：九六幺幺零，反诈专线。
